about: TikTok's channel connections, posting and analytics as the customer life walks them; revocation, cancellation and token-info flows answer the gap.

decisions.demand: Customer life appCredentials setup
decisions.why: Developer dashboard creates the first app credential; no TikTok API operation does.

decisions.demand: Customer life apps setup
decisions.why: Developer-site redirect URIs and verified URL properties have no API operation.

decisions.demand: Customer life people setup
decisions.why: The audience’s accounts exist before the application connects them; no published API creates them.

decisions.demand: Customer life videoStats setup
decisions.why: Audience view and engagement counts are not writable through the application API.

decisions.demand: Customer life media setup
decisions.why: The vendor CDN serves synthetic avatar/cover bytes in the World.

decisions.demand: Customer life locations setup
decisions.why: Location tags are TikTok’s external inventory; no application API creates them.

decisions.demand: Customer life tracks setup
decisions.why: Commercial Music Library tracks are external inventory; no application API creates them.
